navigate a branching tree of text variants

disambiguation: Not the Loom video-recording app; it is a branching interface for language-model text completion.
extras: The author requests Patreon funding to devote more time to this and other independent projects. The README warns MacOS users that some default Alt hotkeys conflict with special-character shortcuts.
intentEvidence: This is a reimplementation of Loom as an Obsidian plugin
problem: Obsidian's editor is linear, offering no way to generate, compare, or branch between multiple alternative continuations of a text.
